attachments.name: 20-0391 Appointment - Mike Beebe and Travis Ritchie - Measures A, B, and J Independent Citizens School Facilities Bond Oversight Committee - Board of Education

enrichment.headline: Ratifies two appointments to the school facilities bond oversight committee for Measures A, B and J
enrichment.sourceIssueCandidate: The text repeats the phrase 'a parent or guardian of a child enrolled in the District' twice in the description of the second appointee.
enrichment.summary: The Board ratifies the Board President's appointment of two people to the Measures A, B, and J Independent Citizens' School Facilities Bond Oversight Committee, both effective February 13, 2020. One represents the business community and serves until June 10, 2020; the other is a parent or guardian active in a parent-teacher group and serves until June 10, 2021.

history.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
history.motion: A motion was made by HintonHodge, seconded by Yee, to Approve the General Consent Report. The motion carried by the following vote

notes.text: The phrase 'a parent or guardian of a child enrolled in the District' is accidentally repeated in the description of the second appointee.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.text: Ratification by the Board of Education of President of Board’s appointment of statutorily and Board Bylaw 9131 eligible individuals named herein to the Measures A, B, and J Independent Citizens’ School Facilities Bond Oversight Committee:  Mike Beebe, active in a business organization representing the business community located within the District, effective February 13, 2020, for unexpired term ending June 10, 2020; and Travis Ritchie, a parent or guardian of a child enrolled in the District and a parent or guardian of a child enrolled in the District and active in a parent-teacher organization, such as the Parent Teacher Association or school site council, effective February 13, 2020, for unexpired term ending June 10, 2021.
